subject: Modi behind the curtain, an old image in the bin
alt: Raju Rahate's cartoon: against a white background, a heavy brown-orange curtain covered with white flower motifs hangs on the right. From behind it Modi peeks out — white beard, glasses, a brown sleeveless vest and blue trousers; one hand holds the curtain aside and his eyes are fixed on a dustbin below. On the left is a white-and-grey dustbin with a long orange cloth hanging out of it and a blue tie stuffed inside. A closed black briefcase lies on the floor beside the bin. Below are the cartoonist's signature: Raju Rahate. Under the cartoon, in three lines of English: Ego, arrogance, ignoring opposition, unilateral decisions, manipulations, scant regard for citizens..
chutki: Modi peeks from behind the curtain while his old clothes lie in the bin in front — an orange cloth and a blue tie, with a closed briefcase beside it. It is as if he has set aside the props of an old image and is now watching, hidden, what he has left behind.

Under the cartoon is the charge-sheet itself: ego, arrogance, ignoring the opposition, one-sided decisions, manipulation, and scant regard for citizens. Rahate's joke is that the clothes may change, the curtain may change, but that list stays exactly as it is — behind the new image is the same old reckoning.
